name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: The colonist studying Algae's distance is lower than both Anders and the Technician.
Cho's distance is between the colonist from Ceres and the Medic.
Exactly one of these is true: Dasari goes with Callisto; Ceres goes with 6 ly; Venus goes with 6 ly.
Cho, 5 ly, and 7 ly go with Navigator, Technician, and Diatoms, in some order.
